extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants (PD/PIs), senior/key personnel, and institutional grants administrators preparing biographical sketches and Research & Related budget forms
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare NIH-format biographical sketches for senior/key personnel and complete the Research & Related (R&R) budget forms for an NIH grant application, including required fields, budget categories, and supporting attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH (format & length)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the specified headers and order for each person; keep each biosketch to a maximum of five pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training (biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include institution and location, degree (if applicable), completion date (MM/YYYY), and field of study for each training entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement (biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: A concise personal statement describing the investigator's research focus, major contributions, training record, and relevance to the proposed work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize current research focus, key tools/approaches developed, mentoring/training outcomes, and how your expertise supports the proposed project (illustrated in the sample personal statement on the page).

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Honors (biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: List positions and employment history and other experience and professional memberships relevant to the investigator.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include dates and titles (e.g., Instructor, Assistant Professor, Professor), key honors, fellowships, editorial roles, committee memberships, and advisory roles that demonstrate qualifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Contribution to Science (biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe major scientific contributions in numbered sections, each supported by representative publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each contribution, provide a short narrative of the contribution's importance and list representative citations (as shown in the examples).

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Research Support (biosketch)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide ongoing research support and research support completed in the past three years, specifying role and project goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List grant numbers, PI names (if subcontract/subcontract PI), project titles, project periods, funding source (e.g., NIH/NIAID), the major goal of the project, and your role (e.g., PI, Subcontract Principal Investigator).

rubrics_metrics.name: URL to complete bibliography
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a URL to a complete bibliography (e.g., an NCBI My Bibliography page).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the full URL to allow reviewers to view the applicant's complete publication list (example provided on page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget: Organization and DUNS
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter name of Organization and Organizational DUNS* on the R&R budget form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide accurate organization name and DUNS for the applicant institution as required by the R&R form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Type and Budget Periods
rubrics_metrics.description: Select Budget Type (Project or Subaward/Consortium) and provide Start Date, End Date, and Budget Period for each period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete these fields for each budget period; repeat the R&R budget sections for each budget period of the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Person information (budget)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each Senior/Key Person include Prefix, First/Middle/Last Name, Suffix, Project Role, Base Salary ($), Calendar Months, Academic Months, Summer Months, Requested Salary ($), Fringe Benefits ($), and Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide complete salary and effort (months) information for each senior/key person (e.g., PD/PI) to show committed effort and requested personnel costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Personnel (budget)
rubrics_metrics.description: List number of personnel by role (Postdoctoral Associates, Graduate Students, Undergraduate Students, Secretarial/Clerical), with Project Role, Calendar/Academic/Summer Months, Requested Salary ($), Fringe Benefits, and Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide counts, roles, effort, and cost breakdown for all other personnel supporting the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment reporting threshold
rubrics_metrics.description: List items and dollar amount for each equipment item exceeding $5,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemize each piece of equipment with cost > $5,000 in Section C (Equipment) and provide a total for all equipment listed in the attached file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel costs (budget)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Domestic Travel Costs (including Canada, Mexico, and U.S. possessions) and Foreign Travel Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemize and total travel expenses separately for domestic and foreign travel in Section D.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant/Trainee Support Costs (budget)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide tuition/fees/health insurance, stipends, travel, subsistence, other costs, and number of participants/trainees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete each line item (tuition, stipends, travel, subsistence, other) and report the total participant/trainee support costs and number of participants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Direct Costs (budget)
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize Other Direct Costs by category: Materials and Supplies; Publication Costs; Consultant Services; ADP/Computer Services; Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs; Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees; Alterations and Renovations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide dollar amounts for each category and list additional items in an attached file when appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct Costs and Total Direct Costs (budget)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total Direct Costs are the sum of sections A through F (personnel, equipment, travel, participant support, other direct costs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute totals accurately for use in indirect cost calculations and the overall budget.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect Costs / Facilities & Administrative Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Indirect Cost Type, Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), and Funds Requested ($). Include Modified Total Direct Costs line item.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the rate, base, and computed indirect cost amount; provide Cognizant Federal Agency name and POC (name and phone) for verification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Direct and Indirect Costs; Fee; Budget Justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Report Total Direct and Indirect Institutional Costs (G + H), Fees (if applicable), and attach a Budget Justification file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only attach one Budget Justification file (the form explicitly states: 'Only attach one file.') and ensure totals reconcile with line-item entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Repeat budget sections for each budget period
rubrics_metrics.description: RESEARCH & RELATED Budget sections (A-K or C-E/F-K as shown) must be completed for each budget period (e.g., Budget Period 1, Budget Period 2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Copy and complete required fields for each subsequent budget period, updating dates, personnel effort, and costs accordingly.
